Recruiter for this role: Britney Dias

Key Responsibilities
AI Feature Design & Delivery - Design, build and run AI powered features using large language models, translating product ideas into reliable, scalable production systems that deliver measurable impact.
LLM Integration & System Architecture - Integrate LLMs into existing applications and services, shaping backend architectures and APIs that balance performance, cost, security and maintainability.
Prompt Engineering & Model Optimisation - Develop, test and refine prompt strategies to improve model accuracy, safety, latency and cost efficiency across different use cases.
Hands-On Engineering - Build and maintain backend services and APIs using TypeScript and modern frameworks, contributing clean, well documented and maintainable code aligned with engineering best practice.
Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with product, data and design partners to identify high value AI opportunities and shape solutions that are feasible, testable and aligned to user needs.
Evaluation & Monitoring - Define and implement evaluation approaches for LLM based systems, including logging, metrics and experimentation, to continuously improve quality and reliability in production.
Scalable AI Patterns - Contribute to shared approaches, architectural patterns and standards for building AI driven features across the platform.
Risk, Privacy & Cost Awareness - Make informed engineering decisions that consider data privacy, model risk, operational resilience and commercial constraints.
Continuous Learning & Innovation - Stay current with emerging AI technologies, tools and techniques, proactively recommending improvements that enhance outcomes for users and teams.
Knowledge, skills and experience required
Our tech stack includes TypeScript (Node.js and React), AWS, Kubernetes, DataDog, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Mongo, and Kafka.
A strong foundation in software engineering, with hands-on experience building, shipping and operating scalable, production-grade systems.
Proven experience working with modern JavaScript and TypeScript stacks, including Node.js and associated backend frameworks, and confidence contributing to clean, maintainable codebases.
Practical experience integrating large language models into real applications, using APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic or similar, with an understanding of prompt design, evaluation and operational trade-offs.
Confidence designing and working with APIs and backend services, including RESTful architectures and integration patterns that support reliability and scale.
Familiarity with cloud-native environments and production tooling, including containerisation, monitoring and deployment practices, ideally within AWS-based ecosystems.
Experience working with data stores such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB and or vector databases, with an understanding of how data design supports AI driven use cases.
The ability to reason about cost, latency, privacy and risk when designing AI powered systems, and to make pragmatic engineering decisions within real-world constraints.
Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail, with a mindset oriented toward iteration, evidence and continuous improvement.
The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and simply to a range of audiences, from engineers to product partners and non-technical stakeholders.
Curiosity and adaptability, with a genuine interest in staying current with emerging AI tools, techniques and best practices, and applying them thoughtfully rather than reactively.
A collaborative approach and empathy for users and teammates, contributing positively to a team environment and shared ownership of outcomes.
We encourage applications from people who want to grow into this role and welcome those who bring diverse perspectives, career paths, and experiences.

Python AI Engineer / GenAI Backend Developer

We are looking for some fresh talents
We are looking for a Python AI Engineer / GenAI Backend Developer to join our team.
We are looking for an AI Engineer / GenAI Backend Developer with 1 to 1.5 years of experience who can build practical AI applications by combining Python backend engineering, Generative AI, RAG, and Agentic AI.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI/Flask, LLMs, RAG, LangChain or LangGraph, vector databases, REST APIs, and cloud platforms. They should be comfortable building AI-powered applications, integrating APIs and tools, and developing reliable backend services.


Key Areas

Agentic AI: AI agents, basic LangGraph workflows, tool calling, and agent workflows
Generative AI: LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, context management, and basic AI evaluation
RAG: Document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, and vector databases
Backend: Python, FastAPI/Flask, REST APIs, OOP, and clean coding practices
Cloud: Basic experience with AWS or other cloud platforms
Databases: PostgreSQL/MySQL, NoSQL basics, and familiarity with vector databases
Engineering: Docker, Git/GitHub, unit testing, debugging, logging, and API development
AI-Assisted Development: Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI coding tools


What We're Looking For

We're looking for engineers who can build and debug practical GenAI applications, not just understand AI terminology. You should have a strong foundation in Python and backend development, along with practical knowledge of LLMs, RAG, embeddings, and AI agents. You should be willing to learn new AI technologies and work across backend and GenAI components. Strong problem-solving, debugging, communication, learning ability, and ownership are essential. We also value developers who use AI coding assistants to improve productivity while taking full ownership of the code, testing, security, and technical decisions.


Experience

1 to 2 years

2

Role Overview:

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Program Manager to lead end-to-end customer project deliveries across Data Engineering, Cloud Transformation, Advanced Analytics, MLOps and AI-driven solutions within the HCMI (Healthcare, Consumer, Manufacturing and Information Services) domain.

You will own the successful execution of complex, multi-million-dollar client engagements, drive exceptional customer satisfaction, ensure profitable delivery, and scale a high-performing delivery organization in one of the fastest-growing technology domains.

This is a pivotal leadership role for a services/product company focused on Data + Cloud + AI, combining deep technical acumen with strong P&L ownership, C-level client advisory, and delivery excellence. .

Required Qualifications

15+ years in Data Engineering, AI/ML delivery, or cloud transformation.
Minimum 8-10 years of mandatory HCMI domain experience.
Hands-on experience operationalizing LLM-based enterprise solutions.
Experience managing multi-million-dollar transformation programs.
Executive storytelling and consultative problem framing
Commercial acumen (ROI, TCO, pricing constructs)
Leadership and cross-functional influence
Strong written and verbal communication
Execution discipline in ambiguous environments

Key Responsibilities:

Own full project/program delivery lifecycle - planning, estimation, execution, monitoring, risk management, and closure.
Lead all customer deliveries with a AI-First mindset: Every engagement must evaluate and embed Artificial Intellligence and intelligent automation opportunities from day one (solution blueprinting, architecture, development, and operations).
Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery with focus on velocity, quality metrics (defect rates, test coverage, DORA metrics), scalability, security and customer satisfaction.
Build and scale high-performing engineering teams (Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake, AI, etc.); handle hiring, onboarding, performance management, career growth, and retention.
Build, mentor, and scale a delivery team that lives and breathes AI-First culture.
Manage relationships with internal stakeholders, product teams, business units, and external vendors/partners (nearshore/offshore delivery centers).
Identify and remove delivery impediments; escalate effectively when needed and drive continuous process improvement (CI/CD, DevOps, automation).
Prepare and track budgets, forecasts, resource plans, and engineering KPIs; report progress through dashboards and executive reviews.
Conduct risk & dependency management across projects; ensure compliance with security, quality, and regulatory standards.
Champion engineering excellence - code quality, architecture governance, technical debt reduction, and adoption of modern practices (Cloud, Microservices, AI/ML where applicable).
Collaborate with Engineering Managers and Tech Leads on capacity planning, technical roadmaps, and resource allocation.
Support proposals and pursuits with solution positioning, win themes, value frameworks, and architecture inputs.
Collaborate with marketing to create vertical POVs, whitepapers, webinars, and thought leadership assets

AppSec / AI Security Engineer

About the Role
Were embedding security and AI governance into the core of our software development lifecycle. This role owns the design and implementation of automated security scanning, code provenance, and governance processes to ensure AI-generated code meets the highest security and compliance standards. If youre a self-driven engineer who enjoys building security automation from the ground up and weaving security seamlessly into development pipelines, this role is for you.
Employment Type: Full-time
Location: Indore (Work from Office)
Key Responsibilities
Build and integrate robust security controls into CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated scanning for source code, dependencies, secrets, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), with security gates enforced on every merge.
Design and implement code provenance tracking to identify AI-generated code, record the AI models used, and capture reviewer approvals throughout the development lifecycle.
Establish structured code review workflows that incorporate technical specifications, security scan results, and code provenance for comprehensive security validation.
Optimize security scanning tools and workflows to minimize false positives, improve signal quality, and drive greater developer adoption.
Investigate, prioritize, and manage security findings through established remediation, tracking, and documentation processes.
Contribute to AI governance standards by defining secure practices for AI tool usage and establishing controls for AI-generated code.
Conduct independent security assessments of internally developed, third-party, and vendor-supplied code to ensure alignment with organizational security standards and requirements.
Required Skills & Experience
Demonstrated experience implementing automated security scanning, policy enforcement, and security gates rather than simply operating existing tools.
Strong knowledge of SAST, SCA, secret scanning, DAST, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security scanning practices and tools.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, with hands-on or working knowledge of AWS and Azure preferred.
Ability to design, build, and own security automation and governance solutions from the ground up.
Strong security judgment with the ability to balance risk reduction and developer productivity by minimizing unnecessary alerts and false positives.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex security risks into clear, concise, and business-friendly language.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently assess security risks across internal, third-party, and external codebases.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience securing AI-generated code, with knowledge of LLM security risks, prompt injection, code provenance, and AI governance.
Hands-on experience with security tools such as Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Gitleaks, TruffleHog, Prowler, Trivy, or similar solutions.
AWS certification, preferably Solutions Architect Associate, or willingness to obtain the certification within 90 days.
Security certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, CSSLP, or equivalent are preferred.
Experience developing custom security detection rules and policies, including custom Semgrep rules.
